name: Methysergide

similar.name: Ergotamine
problems: Pulled from the market in New Zealand, first in 2019 — for blood vessel problems and heart harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated low scores for liver and heart concerns for Methysergide [M]. Methysergide shares similarities with a drug named Ergotamine [3]. Ergotamine was pulled from the market in New Zealand starting in 2019 due to heart harm and vascular harm, which means damage to blood vessels [3]. In the United States, Ergotamine also carries a boxed warning, which is an official prominent alert about serious risks [3].
